name: MKTG 6212
title: Special Topics in Consumer Behavior
description: This course examines prominent topics in consumer research, as well as topics of faculty interest and expertise. Students gain an appreciation of current research and methods for investigating consumer behavior research questions, develop their own research ideas, and practice communicating these ideas to other scholars. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Open to Marketing Ph.D. students and other Masters/ Ph.D. students by instructor consent.
